description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the MockModel class, which extends the core Model class, and includes a listener class for model event handling. It tests database interactions, event dispatching, cache behavior, and language-specific SQL joins within the Goteo project.

classes.name: MockModel
classes.description: A mock implementation of the core Model class for testing database interactions and field validations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a record by ID from the mockmodel table.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Placeholder method for saving the model.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Placeholder method for validating the model fields.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns array of language-specific fields.

classes.name: MockModelListener
classes.description: An event subscriber implementing EventSubscriberInterface, handling model lifecycle events to modify the 'name' property before and after create, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Appends ' pre-insert' to model name during creation.

methods.name: onCreated
methods.description: Appends ' post-insert' to model name after creation.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Appends ' pre-update' to model name during update.

methods.name: onUpdated
methods.description: Appends ' post-update' to model name after update.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Appends ' pre-delete' to model name during deletion.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Appends ' post-delete' to model name after deletion.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping ModelEvents to handler method names.

classes.name: ModelTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the MockModel behaviors including database operations, event triggers, cache management, and language-specific SQL generation. It also tests the event dispatching through the listener.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup, disables cache and registers event listener.

methods.name: testGetTable
methods.description: Verifies the getTable method returns 'mockmodel'.

methods.name: testIdealiza
methods.description: Tests the static and instance idealiza function with Unicode text.

methods.name: testInstanceQuery
methods.description: Tests database query creation and cache behavior.

methods.name: testFailQuery
methods.description: Ensures invalid SQL throws PDOException.

methods.name: testCreateTable
methods.description: Creates a temporary table in the database for testing insert operations.

methods.name: testDbInsert
methods.description: Tests inserting data into mockmodel table and fetching it back.

methods.name: testDbUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating existing records in the mockmodel table.

methods.name: testDbInsertUpdate
methods.description: Tests combined insert or update (upsert) functionality.

methods.name: testDbDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting records and the deprecated delete method.

methods.name: testQueryCache
methods.description: Tests the caching mechanism for query results.

methods.name: testInvalidateCache
methods.description: Verifies that cache can be invalidated and queries fetch fresh data.

methods.name: testLangsSQLJoins
methods.description: Tests the SQL join string generation with various language codes and config states.

methods.name: testInsertEvents
methods.description: Tests event dispatching during insert operations and effect on model property.

methods.name: testUpdateEvents
methods.description: Tests event dispatching during update operations.

methods.name: testDeleteEvents
methods.description: Tests event dispatching during delete operations and cleanup.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Resets cache setting after all tests are run.
